map.权重以百分比计；剩余权重下所需成绩 = (目标 × 总权重 / 100 − 已得: Weights are expressed as percentages; the score needed for the remaining weight = (target × total weight / 100 − weighted points earned) / (remaining weight / 100).

map.加权总分 = Σ(已出成绩ᵢ × 权重ᵢ ÷ 100)（仅统计成绩非空且为数的项: Weighted total = Σ(graded itemᵢ × weightᵢ ÷ 100) (counting only items whose score is non-empty and numeric); graded weight = sum of the weights of those items; remaining weight = total weight − graded weight. Validation: the target score and each weight are required; items with an empty score are excluded. Criteria: required score on the remaining items = (target score × total weight÷100 − weighted total) ÷ (remaining weight÷100); ≤0 is rated "already achieved", >100 "impossible to achieve", and otherwise shown with one decimal.
map.最终加权平均分 = 加权总分 ÷ (总权重 ÷ 100)（按百制权重归一），仅在: Final weighted average = weighted total ÷ (total weight ÷ 100) (normalized on the 100-point weight basis), given only when all items are graded and the total weight >0, otherwise "some scores not yet available" is shown. Validation: the target score and each weight are required. Criteria: output together with total weight/graded weight/remaining weight/required remaining score in the same table.
map.权重归一：结果按总权重归一，单项权重为 0–100，合计须大于 0。: Normalization: results are normalized by total weight; each weight must be 0–100 and the total must be positive.
map.示例：科目权重 60/40，成绩 90/80 → 加权分 = (90×60+80: Example: subject weights 60/40 with scores 90/80 give (90×60+80×40) ÷ 100 = 86. Each weight must be 0–100 and the total must be positive; results are normalized by total weight.
